BiblicalUsage: Shebarim means the breaches, and it is a place on the road of defeat: the men of Ai chased Israel from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down, so that the hearts of the people melted. It is named once, and only as a marker of flight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe places of defeat are named so we remember what caused them. Israel ran to Shebarim because of hidden sin in the camp, and I hold that the road back starts with dealing with it.
